_meta.description: ZZZ agent display names (English PC client) → ZOD key. Both short names and full in-game names are accepted. ZOD keys are sourced from the fairy DB (to_zod_key of the canonical short name). Patch by adding entries; do not change existing keys (optimizer data will reference them).
_meta.2026-07-27_update: Added Remielle + Sigrid from the fairy agents table. No full-name aliases: Remielle's full_name equals her short name, and Sigrid's is the raw asset codename (Avatar_Female_Size03_Sigrid_En), which never appears on screen. Also added Norma (hakushin_id 1571), a pre-existing omission rather than new 3.1 content: she was created in fairy 2026-05-21 alongside Velina/Pyrois/Promeia/Cissia/Nangong Yu/Aria/Sunna/Dialyn/Starlight - Billy, all nine of which were already present, and was the only member of that batch missed by the 2026-06-09 regeneration. She scored 61.5 against the nearest existing agent, below the 85 floor, so she was rejected as unknown_agent rather than mismatched. full_name equals her short name, so no alias.
_meta.2026-07-30_update: Live-client corrections from live_20260730_085008. Added full name "Remielle Dan": the 2026-07-27 note claimed her full_name equals her short name, but the English PC client renders "Remielle Dan" on the agent detail page, so every scan read a name absent from this table and scored 84.0 against the 85 floor -> unknown_agent. Added OCR alias "Gingyi" alongside the existing Ginayi/Oinayi: Tesseract reads Qingyi's Q as G, scoring 83.3 and dropping her from the export.
